correctness.rationale: The recursive root/component model and colored-broom model both enumerate 29,616 maximal tubings of K4,4, with exactly 70 S4×S4 color-spine patterns and orbit sizes summing to 29,616. Every tubing has 8 nested tubes including full mask 255; deleting any proper tube produces precisely two completions, yielding 7-regular graph with 103,656 undirected edges. Independent integer implementation rebuilt this entire flip graph and ran breadth-first shortest paths from ALL 70 pattern representatives (not partial sampling), obtaining eccentricity 15+s at each pattern; aggregate counts ecc19:48,20:768,21:5760,22:23040 and exact diameter22. The actual package verify.py performs a second generic-search versus broom enumeration and compares each representative to orbit_certificate.json, providing farthest witnesses. Since symmetry orbits exhaust the finite vertex set and BFS explores all 29,616 nodes each time, this is a rigorous bounded finite determination.

value.rationale: Diameter of balanced complete-bipartite graph associahedra is a specifically motivated open subfamily in published work. Resolving the canonical first genuinely balanced K4,4 at diameter 22, and classifying all 29,616 vertices by their full eccentricities, gives an independently useful exact finite metric baseline. The 70-orbit symmetry reduction makes the certificate finite and reusable; no general family theorem is needed for the value of this natural named case.

limitations: Not a formula for all Kp,p, nor all pairwise distances; the orbit-table proof depends on an exhaustive finite BFS and exact graph construction.
Residual literature indexing risk for precomputed small-case rotation distances.
